verdict.rationale: Copilot's cloud agent automations produce PRs that go through GitHub's native review and merge flow (docs-8), and enterprises can track agent activity via audit logs and a governance control plane (docs-23, docs-14), which implicitly supports versioning/review of automated changes. However, there is no explicit documentation of rolling back or reverting a scheduled/event-driven automation itself (as opposed to reverting a code change via git), nor version history for automation configs. Missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for automations, versioning of automation definitions/configs, independent hands-on confirmation of these workflows.
